'''[[Lady/Legends|Lady]] Saro''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Atoan]] and the High [[Priestess/Legends|Priestess]] of [[Atoa/Legends|Atoa]].<ref name="TLC1">[[Darth Vader and the Lost Command 1|''Darth Vader and the Lost Command'' 1]]</ref> She claimed that her ability to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] stemmed from a ritual she performed on a captured [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]], in which she removed and consumed the trooper's tongue. She claimed to know the location of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Garoche Tarkin]], though she would not divulge the information unless [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] declared Saro the [[Queen/Legends|queen]] of the [[Ghost Nebula/Legends|Ghost Nebula]].<ref name="TLC2">[[Darth Vader and the Lost Command 2|''Darth Vader and the Lost Command'' 2]]</ref> She led Lord Vader and the Imperials on a hunt for Tarkin, eradicating many Atoans in the process. It was revealed when Captain [[Shale (human)|Shale]] turned his [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]] against Lord Vader that not only was Tarkin alive, but an enemy of the Empire who had defected after becoming disgusted by the atrocities he was ordered to commit, and Lady Saro forgiving him. Shale had defected along with him onto the Atoan side. Lady Saro had become Tarkin's lover. She also projected an image of [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], Vader's deceased wife, from reading into his heart, which caused him some despair. When learning of this ability, he attempted to kill her in despair-driven madness to get her to return Padmé to him, although he relented after she told him she was pregnant, presumably out of guilt for his role in Padmé's death. Vader however saw through her lie and later killed them both in an attempted [[Death/Legends|suicide]] by [[Ambush on the Atoan crystal planet|collapsing the Atoan cathedral on top of them]], with Garoche's death blamed on the Atoan Insurgents to further his father [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin's]] hatred of all Rebels.<ref name="TLC5" />
